phases.name: Player details: derived attributes, then rows, player screen and Back

steps.name: Domain precursor: attributes, condition and derived overall in src/domain/squad.ts (about 3h, no dependencies; not shipped alone)
criteria: Every generated player has exactly four attributes (goalkeeping, defending, passing, shooting), each a whole number from 1 to 20, and a whole-number condition from 75 to 100, for any seed and all 8 clubs

Overall equals deriveOverall(position, attributes) (non-negative weights per position summing to 10, round half up) and lies between the lowest and highest attribute, so it stays a whole number from 1 to 20
The same seed and club give a deep-equal squad; the 18 players of a squad do not all share the same attribute values; names, positions and ages are identical to S-002 for every seed

Attributes and condition come from the separate stream deriveSeed(seed, 100 + clubIndex) with 5 draws per player; an invalid club index still raises RangeError; no ambient randomness or wall-clock time in src/domain/

ci:lint, ci:typecheck and ci:test are green; tests/acceptance/S-002/* and unchanged-identity.test.ts stay green; derive-overall.test.ts and player-attributes.test.ts are moved into tests/acceptance/S-003/ (git mv, .pending dropped) in the same commit as the code
steps.scenario_name: Given any 32-bit seed, when all 8 clubs' squads are generated (also tests/acceptance/S-003/derive-overall.test.ts: Given any position and any attributes from 1 to 20)

steps.name: Tappable squad rows, player screen and Back: update cases, player.ts, row buttons, main.ts, CSS, e2e (about 5h, depends on 01-01)
criteria: Tapping a squad row (exactly one button per list item, 44px or taller, row text unchanged) opens the player screen in 1 tap: one h1 with the player name, lines Position, Age and Overall equal to the row, a list named Attributes with four items in order, a Condition N% line outside the list, and focus on the h1
Back on the player screen returns to the same club's squad (18 items) and Back again returns to the club home; the Back button is 44px or taller

ViewPlayer is a no-op from any screen but the squad, for an unknown club, and for an index of -1, 18, 1.5, NaN or Infinity; Back from a player screen with an unknown club or invalid index is a no-op; inputs are never mutated; update is split into per-action helpers to stay under the oxlint complexity cap of 15

The same seed gives identical player screens on fresh visits, goalkeepers and forwards open with an invalid seed, no horizontal scroll at 390px and no console errors; generated text enters the DOM only through el()/textContent

player-navigation.test.ts and S-003-player.spec.ts are moved into tests/ (.pending dropped); the S-002 e2e test 'squad rows are display-only, not buttons' is renamed 'each squad row is exactly one button' and asserts 18 items each holding exactly one button (never deleted); src/app/state.ts is added to the Stryker mutate list
ci:lint, ci:typecheck, ci:test and ci:e2e are green; tests/protected/S-001..S-003 pass; zero .pending files remain under docs/feature/S-003/distill/pending/
steps.scenario_name: @walking_skeleton @kpi Sam taps a player's row in 1 tap, sees the player, taps Back in 1 tap, then Back to the club home (also tests/acceptance/S-003/player-navigation.test.ts: Given the squad, when Sam taps the first player's row, then that club's player 0 is shown)
